```{r}
# --- Define input directory ---
blast_dir <- file.path(LOCUS_DIR, "outputs", "blast")
blast_files <- list.files(blast_dir, pattern = "blast_results_.*\\.tab$", full.names = TRUE)

# --- Define geographic filter keywords ---
exclude_keywords <- c(
  "China", "Japan", "JPN", "Australia", "America", "Brazil", "Africa", 
  "Asia", "tropical", "subtropical", "Indo-Pacific", "Caribbean",
  "Madagascar", "New Zealand", "South America", "North America",
  # Japanese regions
  "Honshu", "Hokkaido", "Kyushu", "Shikoku", "Ryukyu",
  # Chinese regions
  "Sichuan", "Yunnan", "Guangdong", "Tibet",
  # Other common non-European areas
  "Pacific", "India", "Indonesia", "Philippines", "Malaysia"
)

# --- Function to extract genus and species from accession ---
get_genus_species <- function(acc) {
  tryCatch({
    summary <- entrez_summary(db = "nuccore", id = acc)
    title <- summary$title
    species <- stringr::str_extract(title, "^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[a-z]+")
    genus <- stringr::word(species, 1)
    return(c(species = species, genus = genus))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(c(species = NA, genus = NA))
  })
}

# --- Process all files and combine into a single dataframe ---
taxonomy_df <- purrr::map_dfr(blast_files, function(file) {
  if (file.info(file)$size == 0) {
    message("Skipping empty file: ", basename(file))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  code <- stringr::str_extract(basename(file), "(?<=blast_results_).*?(?=_ASVs)")
  
  blast <- read.table(file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (nrow(blast) == 0) {
    message("No hits found in file: ", basename(file))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  blast <- blast %>%
    mutate(
      asv = V1,
      asv_number = str_extract(asv, "(?<=ASV)\\d+"),
      code = paste0(code, "_P", asv_number),
      accession = str_extract(V2, "(?<=\\|)[A-Z]{1,2}_?\\d+\\.\\d+")
    )
  
  if (all(is.na(blast$accession))) {
    message("No valid accessions in file: ", basename(file))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  unique_accessions <- unique(na.omit(blast$accession))
  tax_info <- t(sapply(unique_accessions, get_genus_species))
  tax_df <- data.frame(accession = unique_accessions, tax_info, row.names = NULL)
  
  blast_tax <- left_join(blast, tax_df, by = "accession") %>%
    filter(!is.na(genus)) %>%
    mutate(
      geographic_filter = if_else(
        str_detect(species, str_c(exclude_keywords, collapse = "|")),
        "unlikely",
        "european"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(code, asv, genus, species, accession, geographic_filter)
  
  return(blast_tax)
})

taxonomy_df


```

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "metabarcoding_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(code = sub("^([A-I])0", "\\1", code))

final_file <- 
  taxonomy_df %>% 
  left_join(metadata) %>% 
  filter(sample_name!="NA") %>% 
  mutate(sample_name = if_else(day %in% c(5, 10),
                               paste(nestbox, sample_name, sep = "_"),
                               sample_name)) %>% 
  distinct(sample_name, species, .keep_all = TRUE)

write.csv(final_file, 
          file.path(LOCUS_DIR, "outputs", "rbcl_species.csv"), 
          row.names = F)
```

```{r}
species <- read.csv(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                              "outputs", 
                              "coi_species.csv"), 
                    header = T)

faecal_samples <- 
  read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, 
                     "faecal_samples.csv"),
                      header=T) %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_name = case_when(
      is.na(bto_ring) ~ paste0(nb, "_n", ind),
      TRUE ~ bto_ring
    )
  ) %>% select(sample_name, date)

nb <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "nb_info.csv"), header=T) %>% 
  rename(nestbox=nb)
```

```{r}
# Species abundance per sample
species_abundance <- species %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarise(species_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Genus abundance per sample (unique genera only)
genus_abundance <- species %>%
  distinct(sample_name, genus) %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarise(genus_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Species abundance plot
(ggplot(species_abundance, aes(x = species_count)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  custom_theme +
  labs(
    title = "Species abundance per sample",
    y = "\nCount\n",
    x = "\nSpecies count\n"

        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=12))
)+(
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(sysfonts)

# Add Roboto Condensed and enable showtext
font_add_google("Roboto Condensed", "roboto_condensed")
showtext_auto()

custom_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Species abundance across all samples
species_abundance <- species %>%
  count(species, name = "abundance") %>%
  arrange(desc(abundance))

# Genus abundance across all samples
genus_abundance <- species %>%
  count(genus, name = "abundance") %>%
  arrange(desc(abundance))

# Plot species abundance (top 20 to avoid clutter)
plot_species <- ggplot(species_abundance %>% slice_max(abundance, n = 20),
       aes(x = reorder(species, abundance), y = abundance)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  custom_theme +
  labs(
    title = "Species abundance across all samples",
    x = "\nSpecies\n",
    y = "\nAbundance\n"
  )

# Plot genus abundance
plot_genus <- ggplot(genus_abundance %>% slice_max(abundance, n = 20),
       aes(x = reorder(genus, abundance), y = abundance)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  custom_theme +
  labs(
    title = "Genus abundance across all samples",
    x = "\nGenus\n",
    y = "\nAbundance\n"
  )

plot_species+plot_genus
```

```{r}
richness <- 
  species %>% 
  left_join(nb, by="nestbox") %>% 
  left_join(faecal_samples, by="sample_name") %>%
  group_by(date, sample_name, nestbox, day, x, y, edge_EDI, altitude_m, 
           aspect,
           habitat) %>%
  summarise(richness = n_distinct(species))

richness$nestbox <- as.factor(richness$nestbox)
richness$sample_name <- as.factor(richness$sample_name)
richness$day <- as.factor(richness$day)

richness %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(day), y = richness)) +
  geom_dots(
    aes(y = richness),
    side = "top",     # dots on top of axis
    dotsize = 1,      # size of the dots
    binwidth = 1,     # bin width to prevent overlap
    color = "darkgrey",
    fill = "darkgrey",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,  # Or use mean_se if preferred
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(x = "\nDay", y = "Richness\n")

# Find nestboxes that have all three days represented
complete_nestboxes <- richness %>%
  group_by(nestbox) %>%
  summarize(days_present = list(unique(day))) %>%
  filter(sapply(days_present, function(x) all(c(5, 10, 15) %in% x))) %>%
  pull(nestbox)

# Filter richness to include only those nestboxes
richness_filtered <- richness %>%
  filter(nestbox %in% complete_nestboxes)

# Then plot as you did, but with filtered data:
plot_day<-
  richness_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(day), y = richness)) +
  geom_dots(
    side = "top",     # dots on top of axis
    dotsize = 1,      # size of the dots
    binwidth = 1,     # bin width to prevent overlap
    color = "darkgrey",
    fill = "darkgrey",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,  # mean and confidence interval
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                 # remove all gridlines
    axis.line = element_blank(),                  # remove default axis lines
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),  # add bottom x axis
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),    # add left y axis
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(title="COI",
       x = "\nDay", 
       y = "Richness\n")

# Convert collection_date to factor or Date if needed
# richness_filtered$collection_date <- as.Date(richness_filtered$collection_date)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)  # for better dot distribution
library(dplyr)

# Custom summary function that caps lower CI at 0
mean_cl_no_neg <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
  data.frame(y = m, ymin = pmax(0, m - 1.96 * se), ymax = m + 1.96 * se)
}

plot_date <-
  richness_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(date), y = richness, color = as.factor(day))) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black",
    aes(group = 1)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_no_neg,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    aes(group = 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                 # remove all gridlines
    axis.line = element_blank(),                  # remove default axis lines
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),  # add bottom x axis
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),    # add left y axis
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12,angle=45, hjust=1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "COI",
    x = "\n",
    y = "Richness\n",
    color = "Day"
  )

plot_day/plot_date

# Filter data for complete nestboxes
richness_filtered <- richness %>%
  filter(nestbox %in% complete_nestboxes)

# Fit linear mixed model
model <- lme4::lmer(richness ~ factor(day) + (1 | nestbox/sample_name), data = richness_filtered)

# Summary with p-values
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# If not Date, convert it:
richness$date <- as.Date(richness$date)

# Now compute days since start
richness$days_since_start <- as.numeric(richness$date - min(richness$date, na.rm = TRUE))

# Check result
head(richness[, c("date", "days_since_start")])

model_quant <- lmer(richness ~ day + days_since_start + (1 | nestbox/sample_name), data = richness)
summary(model_quant)

# Compare to model without days_since_start:
model_null <- lmer(richness ~ day + (1 | nestbox/sample_name), data = richness)
anova(model_null, model_quant)
```

```{r}
library(gganimate)

# Filter only days 5, 10, 15
plot_data <- richness %>%
  filter(day %in% c(5, 10, 15))

# Create the plot with animation frame by 'day'
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = richness)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "magma") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray30"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "white"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white")
  ) +
  labs(x = "\nEasting", y = "Northing\n", color = "Richness") +
  # Animate by day
  transition_states(day, state_length = 2, wrap = FALSE) +
  ease_aes('cubic-in-out') +
  ggtitle('Day: {closest_state}')

# Render and save gif (change filename and duration as you want)
animate(p, nframes = 60, fps = 10, width = 600, height = 400, renderer = gifski_renderer("richness_days.gif"))
```
